stem:
Meena wants to measure the length of her notebook at home, but the end of her plastic ruler is broken and the zero mark is missing. She places one end of the notebook against the 2 cm mark and finds that the other end lines up with the 15 cm mark.
What is the length of the notebook?

options.text: 15 cm, because the far end reads 15 cm
13 cm, because 15 cm minus 2 cm is 13 cm
17 cm, because 15 cm plus 2 cm is 17 cm
2 cm, because the notebook starts at the 2 cm mark

teacher.key_rationale: Length equals the difference between the two end readings: 15 cm − 2 cm = 13 cm, so B is correct. Option A is the trap for a student who treats the far endpoint reading as the length even though the object did not start at zero.
